title: Parking Lot System
summary: Design an automated multi-floor parking lot system that assigns spots, tracks occupancy, and calculates fees.
requirements: Support multiple vehicle types: Motorcycle, Car, Bus/Truck.
Support distinct spot types: Compact, Regular, Large, Electric Vehicle (EV).
Assign the nearest available spot on entry and free it upon exit.
Issue a parking ticket on entry with timestamp and spot details.
Calculate parking fee on exit based on duration and vehicle type.
Display real-time available spots count per floor and type.
edge_cases: Lot is completely full when a vehicle arrives.
Vehicle stays for less than the minimum billing threshold (e.g., grace period).
Large vehicle arrives when only scattered small spots are open.
Two vehicles arrive at the same time and only one spot is left
common_pitfalls: Hardcoding spot allocation logic directly inside the ParkingLot class instead of using an extensible strategy.
Not distinguishing between vehicle type and spot type (e.g., a motorcycle can park in a regular spot if compact is full).
Forgetting concurrency when multiple gates allocate spots simultaneously.
change_request: The owner wants to introduce surge pricing based on peak entry hours and real-time occupancy percentage.

title: Vending Machine
summary: Design a stateful vending machine that accepts money, manages inventory, and dispenses items with correct change.
requirements: Support item selection by code or shelf location.
Accept cash and coin denominations (e.g., $1, $5, quarters, dimes).
Maintain internal coin/cash inventory to dispense change.
Dispense selected item only when inserted money is greater than or equal to item price.
Return exact change to the user after item dispensation.
Allow the user to cancel transaction and receive a full refund before dispensation.
edge_cases: Item is out of stock after code selection.
Machine lacks sufficient change to return the exact balance.
User cancels mid-transaction after inserting partial amount.
Power failure or hardware jam during physical item drop.
common_pitfalls: Using complex boolean flags instead of a State Pattern to track idle, money inserted, dispensing, and out-of-order states.
Mixing cash collection logic with inventory management inside one giant God object.
Failing to rollback transaction balance when change cannot be made.
change_request: The operator wants to accept contactless digital wallet payments (NFC/QR code) alongside cash.

title: Elevator System
summary: Design a controller for a bank of elevators handling passenger requests across multiple floors efficiently.
requirements: Control multiple elevator cars servicing N floors in a commercial building.
Support external hall calls (floor number, UP or DOWN direction).
Support internal car calls (destination floor buttons).
Dispatch the most suitable elevator car for an incoming hall request.
Operate elevator car door cycle (open, wait, close) safely at arrival floor.
Track elevator car state: current floor, moving direction (UP, DOWN, IDLE), and doors.
edge_cases: Passenger weight exceeds maximum load limit.
Emergency stop button pressed while car is in motion between floors.
All elevators are moving away from an incoming call floor.
Continuous button presses on every floor by passengers.
common_pitfalls: Tight coupling between elevator hardware controls and the dispatch algorithm (LOOK / SCAN / FCFS).
Treating each elevator as completely independent without a central dispatcher controller.
Deadlock or starvation when calls keep getting added to opposite direction queues.
change_request: During morning rush hour (8 AM to 10 AM), idle cars must automatically park on the ground floor instead of staying on their last drop-off floor.
